project_context: Synthetic schema-v2 control-plane example only. The mutable plan may be revised by Astra, but no real project experiment, external side effect, or approved evidence change is allowed.
ultimate_purpose: Demonstrate and verify the orchestration control flow using only synthetic artifacts, without performing or changing real project work or evidence.
experiment_plan: Use deterministic scripted role outputs only.
Exercise routing, recovery, review, persistence, and termination without live model or project execution.
datasets: Synthetic in-memory and temporary-file fixtures only.
evaluation_criteria: All required routes and authority boundaries are represented in durable evidence.
Fresh Reviewer and Luna session identities are unique and never resumed.
No real experiment, paid resource, or approved project evidence is touched.
approaches: Run the deterministic ScriptedBackend dry-run scenarios.
Inspect checkpoints, transition logs, review packets, recovery records, and receipts.

stages.goal: Validate the schema-v2 control-plane specification and prepare synthetic evidence only.
acceptance_criteria: The orchestration specification validates with an immutable ultimate purpose and a versioned mutable plan.

stages.goal: Verify the major orchestration routes using scripted role results.
acceptance_criteria: The scripted dry run produces evidence for Sol, fresh Luna, fresh Reviewer, the three allowed USER policies, automatic recovery, resume, and END routes.
